mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact two-sided scaled inverse identities; finite power image equals the scaled-inverse congruence image and reductions of the next-level image
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Q and Z/(p^r), two by two matrices; no floating point
mathematics.conventions: row-major matrix-entry order; s is the maximum p-denominator exponent in the inverse derivative; m=s+1; H=m+s

bounds.exhaustive_correction_tuples: All four-entry tuples modulo p^s at H, and modulo p^(s+1) at H+1

non_claims: Finite checks do not prove infinite existence or uniqueness
No claim for derivatives singular over Qp
Not exhaustive over all centers or primes
